components.name: Intake
components.description: Food and drink entering the body.

components.name: Stomach and small intestine
components.description: Breaks food into glucose, amino acids and fats and absorbs them.

components.name: Lymphatic route
components.description: Carries absorbed fat from the gut to the blood, bypassing the liver at first.

components.name: Portal vein
components.description: Carries absorbed glucose and amino acids from the gut straight to the liver.

components.name: Liver
components.description: Stores glucose as glycogen, releases glucose between meals, and makes glucose and fat.

components.name: Bloodstream
components.description: Carries fuel and signals between organs.

components.name: Pancreas
components.description: Releases insulin and glucagon in response to blood glucose.

components.name: Skeletal muscle
components.description: Burns and stores fuel; the largest site of glucose uptake after a meal.

components.name: Adipose tissue
components.description: Stores fat and releases fatty acids between meals.

components.name: Brain
components.description: Burns glucose continuously and directs the autonomic nervous system.

components.name: Exhaust (lungs, kidneys, skin)
components.description: Where the products of burning fuel leave the body: carbon dioxide, water and heat.

components.name: Kidneys (detail)
components.description: Placeholder; kidney detail is out of scope for v1.

components.name: Respiratory loop
components.description: Placeholder; respiratory detail is out of scope for v1.

components.name: Adrenal glands

flows.notes: Carbohydrate is digested to glucose before absorption.
The liver stores some as glycogen.
Meal glucose the liver passes on to the blood.
Used for repair; can be converted to glucose.
Reaches the blood before the liver.
Fat is stored mainly in adipose tissue.
Glycogen breakdown and glucose made from amino acids; runs between meals.
Excess fuel; linked to fatty liver.
Glucose and fatty acids burned with oxygen.

controls.name: Insulin
controls.effect: Moves glucose into muscle and fat and promotes storage; holds back glucose release by the liver and fat release by adipose.

controls.name: Glucagon
controls.effect: Raises glucose release by the liver between meals.

controls.name: GLP-1
controls.effect: Gut hormone; slows stomach emptying and boosts insulin release after a meal.

controls.name: GIP
controls.effect: Gut hormone; boosts insulin release after a meal.

controls.name: CCK
controls.effect: Gut hormone released by fat and protein; slows stomach emptying and signals fullness.

controls.name: Leptin
controls.effect: Long-term satiety signal from fat stores.

controls.name: Cortisol
controls.effect: Stress hormone; raises glucose production by the liver.

controls.name: Adrenaline
controls.effect: Stress hormone; releases stored glucose and fat quickly.

controls.name: Thyroid hormone
controls.effect: Sets the overall rate at which fuel is burned.

controls.name: Autonomic nervous system
controls.effect: Fast nervous control of fuel release, alongside the hormones.
